kangaroo-at-2025-junior-04.prompt: Every year, the third Thursday in March is Kangaroo Day. What is the earliest calendar day that can be a Kangaroo Day?

kangaroo-at-2025-junior-08.prompt: Luka has dogs, rabbits and cats as pets. Eight of these pets are not dogs, five of these pets are not rabbits and seven of these pets are not cats. How many pets does Luka have?

kangaroo-at-2025-junior-09.prompt: Katrin and Thomas are both celebrating their birthday today. Thomas notices that $\frac{1}{19}$ of Katrin's age is the same as $\frac{1}{17}$ of his. Together they are older than 40 years and younger than 100 years. How old is Katrin?

kangaroo-at-2025-junior-13.prompt: The four-digit number $80\square\square$ is missing its last two digits. We know that this number is divisible by 8 and 9. What is the product of the last two digits?

kangaroo-at-2025-junior-19.prompt: Five bricks form a wall (see figure). Peter can only remove a brick if there is no other brick directly above it.
